mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and unemployment rate above 6.5% indicate aggressive monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% and UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential construction activity, measured by HOUST above 1500 thousand units for two consecutive months, signals robust consumer demand that supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth over three consecutive months indicates strengthening economic activity that supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved corporate output and margins.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits above 1500 and industrial production above 105 indicate robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through synchronized demand and supply growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500 and INDPRO exceeds 105 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.5% for two consecutive months.
